A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same complete 48-page ACE technical report, including Appendices A–H. Extracted text and rendered pages 2–48 are identical. Differences are confined to the title-page affiliation, its typography, and the arXiv version/date stamp.

before.justification: v1 reports original MagicBrush evaluations and an ACE benchmark user study in Tables 1–2, plus Emu Edit, facial-editing, and local text-rendering results in Appendix E, Tables 5–7.

after.justification: v2 retains the original benchmark evaluations and user-study outcomes in Tables 1–2 and 5–7, together with the qualitative generation and editing results.

M1.justification: Sections 2–3 retain identical CU/LCU inputs, condition tokenization, image indicator embeddings, long-context attention, and data construction procedures. Appendix F's workflow-distillation and chatbot procedures are also unchanged.

E1.justification: The training task coverage in Appendix B and evaluations on MagicBrush, Emu Edit, and the ACE benchmark are unchanged, including global/local editing, reference generation, and multi-turn/long-context scenarios.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is identical within Tables 1–2 and 5–7 and Figure 5. For example, the local text-rendering comparison retains both UDiffText and AnyText.

E3.justification: Evaluation metrics, benchmark sample counts, single-turn and multi-turn procedures, and the five-designer user study are unchanged. Appendix D and Table 4 retain the same model size and training settings.

E4.justification: The long-context comparison in Table 1, image-order test in Figure 25, facial-similarity analysis in Appendix E, and application case studies in Appendix F are retained unchanged.

E5.justification: Statistical reporting is identical, including Appendix E's facial-similarity mean, standard deviation, and threshold construction. No run-count, seed, confidence-interval, or significance-test information is added or removed.

E6.justification: All numerical results and qualitative outputs are identical. For example, ACE's Emu Edit CLIPimg and DINO scores remain 0.8952 and 0.8620 in Table 5, and its local text-rendering sentence accuracy remains 0.5767 in Table 7.

T1.justification: The CU/LCU definitions, embedding and attention equations (1)–(5), chatbot formulation (6), and appendix metric definitions are unchanged. No mathematical assumptions, derivations, or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction's contribution list, and conclusion retain identical claims about unified generation/editing, long-context interaction, the data construction pipeline, benchmark coverage, and competitiveness with specialized models.

C2.justification: Section 4.3 retains the same interpretations of long-context gains and weaker general/style editing. Appendix H preserves the aesthetic-quality gap, multi-intent instruction limitations, hardware constraints, and difficulties with long contexts.

D1.justification: Dataset processing instructions, architecture initialization, optimizer settings, hardware, and training schedules are unchanged. The promised code/model availability statement and embedded external link targets also match.

R1.justification: Appendix A, the reference list, and citations are identical. The paper's novelty positioning and relationship to earlier generation and editing methods are unchanged.

P1.justification: The title-page affiliation changes from 'Wanx Team Alibaba Group' to 'Tongyi Lab', and the arXiv version/date stamp is updated. The remaining prose, headings, section ordering, and appendix structure are identical.

P2.justification: The title-page affiliation changes from two bold labels to one regular-weight label. All figures, tables, captions, and layouts on pages 2–48 are visually identical.

improvement.justification: The revision only updates institutional attribution, affiliation typography, and the arXiv stamp. Methods, evidence, explanations, reproducibility information, and limitations remain identical throughout the main text and appendices, establishing no meaningful net change in paper quality.
